reference.title: Haystack Equip Import File format
reference.shortdesc: The Equip Import File is provided in JSON format. The Equip Import File is used to add, modify, or remove tagGroups in the Haystack dictionary. You can edit the file with any JSON‑capable editor and it must be stored on the target station before import.

ul.li:
Header metadata – including the import file version.
Data entries
FieldDescription
nameName of the tagGroup. If a tagGroup with this name already exists, the definition is overwritten. If not, a new tagGroup is created.
remove
Set to Remove to remove the specified tagGroup from the dictionary
validityRulesObject containing the validity rule definitions for the tagGroup. These influence which tagGroups appear as valid for a component in UI workflows.
hasTagsA space‑delimited list of tag names. Generates an OR‑based Boolean filter. Only specify tag names (omit namespaces for Haystack tags).
isTypeDefines an IsTypeCondition using the module:typeName format. Applies the tagGroup when the component is of the specified type.
hasAncestorSpace‑delimited tag names. Generates a HasAncestorCondition. Multiple entries are evaluated using OR logic.
filterA Boolean NEQL expression used to further qualify whether the tagGroup applies. Must be a fully‑qualified NEQL predicate including the namespace.
tags
Array of discrete tags associated with the tagGroup. Includes marker tags and value tags (value tags are expressed as tagName(tagValue)).
